title: Pick two columns
prompt: Show the title and price of every book. Replace the ___ in the query with the missing column.
hints: The column you need is named price.

cases.name: A different catalogue
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM books; INSERT INTO books VALUES (10, 'Copper Moon', 'Ada Hill', 'Fantasy', 20.0, 100, 2020), (11, 'North Light', 'Raj Dev', 'Travel', 7.5, 180, 2015);

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT title FROM books;
SELECT * FROM books;
SELECT price, title FROM books;
wrongSolutions.why: Returns the columns in the wrong order

title: See the whole table
prompt: Show every column and every row from the books table.

cases.name: A different catalogue
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM books; INSERT INTO books VALUES (10, 'Copper Moon', 'Ada Hill', 'Fantasy', 20.0, 100, 2020);

solutions: SELECT id, title, author, genre, price, pages, year FROM books;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT title, author FROM books;
SELECT * FROM books LIMIT 1;

title: Rename the columns
prompt: Show each book's title as book_title and its author as written_by.
hints: Use AS after a column to give it a new name.

cases.name: A different catalogue
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM books; INSERT INTO books VALUES (10, 'Copper Moon', 'Ada Hill', 'Fantasy', 20.0, 100, 2020);

solutions: SELECT title AS book_title, author AS written_by FROM books;
SELECT title book_title, author written_by FROM books;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT title, author FROM books;
SELECT author AS book_title, title AS written_by FROM books;

title: A new table
prompt: The hiking club wants a simple list of its trails. Show each trail's name as trail and its length_km as distance_km.
hints: The table is called trails. The steps are the same as for books.

cases.name: Different trails
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM trails; INSERT INTO trails VALUES (7, 'Birch Walk', 'West', 3.1, 40), (8, 'High Moor', 'East', 12.6, 610);

solutions: SELECT name AS trail, length_km AS distance_km FROM trails;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT name, length_km FROM trails;
SELECT name AS trail, elevation_m AS distance_km FROM trails;

title: A name with a space
prompt: Show each book's title under a column named exactly Book Title, including the space.
hints: A name containing a space needs double quotes around it.

cases.name: A different catalogue
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM books; INSERT INTO books VALUES (11, 'North Light', 'Raj Dev', 'Travel', 7.5, 180, 2015);

solutions: SELECT title AS "Book Title" FROM books;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT title AS Book_Title FROM books;
wrongSolutions.why: Uses an underscore instead of a space

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT title AS Book Title FROM books;
wrongSolutions.why: A name with a space needs quotes

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT title AS "book title" FROM books;

title: Fix the query
prompt: This query should show each book's title and price, but it fails. Read the error and fix the query.
hints: Look at the punctuation just before FROM.

cases.name: A different catalogue
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM books; INSERT INTO books VALUES (11, 'North Light', 'Raj Dev', 'Travel', 7.5, 180, 2015);

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT title FROM books;
wrongSolutions.why: Removes the price instead of fixing the error

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT price, title FROM books;

title: Add a calculated column
prompt: The shop is adding a 20% tax. Show each book's title and its price multiplied by 1.2, in a column named price_with_tax.
hints: A column can be a calculation, such as price * 1.2. Give it a name with AS.

cases.name: A different catalogue
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM books; INSERT INTO books VALUES (10, 'Copper Moon', 'Ada Hill', 'Fantasy', 20.0, 100, 2020), (11, 'North Light', 'Raj Dev', 'Travel', 7.5, 180, 2015);

solutions: SELECT title, price * 1.2 AS price_with_tax FROM books;
SELECT title, price + price * 0.2 AS price_with_tax FROM books;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT title, price AS price_with_tax FROM books;
SELECT title, price * 0.2 AS price_with_tax FROM books;
SELECT title, price * 1.2 FROM books;

title: Build a shelf label
prompt: Create data for shelf labels. Show each book's title as book, the fixed text paperback as format, and an estimated reading time of 2 minutes per page as minutes_to_read.
hints: Text values go in single quotes.
A fixed value can be selected like a column: 'paperback' AS format.

cases.name: A different catalogue
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM books; INSERT INTO books VALUES (10, 'Copper Moon', 'Ada Hill', 'Fantasy', 20.0, 100, 2020), (11, 'North Light', 'Raj Dev', 'Travel', 7.5, 180, 2015);

solutions: SELECT title AS book, 'paperback' AS format, pages * 2 AS minutes_to_read FROM books;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT title AS book, paperback AS format, pages * 2 AS minutes_to_read FROM books;
wrongSolutions.why: Treats the text as a column because it has no quotes

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT title AS book, 'paperback' AS format, pages / 2 AS minutes_to_read FROM books;
SELECT title AS book, 'paperback' AS format, pages AS minutes_to_read FROM books;
